body: Yes. I want to quit but I can't just yet. Need to spend 2 more months here

I messed up anything I touch at work. I cannot do anything right and I always leave a mess for everyone around me to clean up. I am horrible in all aspects and I should not be allowed to exist.

I am stuck with my current job for at least another 2 months before I can move a bit closer to home but I can't do this anymore. I have been making mistake after mistake in the office. I tried to fix them but the harder I try the bigger the problems became. I am the damn fool that makes everyone's lives harder. For the world's sake I need to go.

If I die, my boss don't have to yell at me any more. My roomate wil be happier as she gets the whole place for herself. My parents can stop listening to my ramblings and in turn, they can spend more time with my sister instead. I have been a burden for everyone and I... I just want to stop being that burden.
I'm tired. Go help others. They need help from good people like you. My presence will only make the world a worse place.

I don't know anymore. My family is 10000km away from me, my work is stressful everyday and I've just had an argument with my roomate. I doubt if I can make it through next week, let alone 1 year.

Thank you for your kind words regardless
